reason: The README provides clear evidence that this plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is model configuration enhancement: it inserts an input-type selector into DeepSeek Harness model add/edit forms so users can explicitly declare whether a custom model supports text and/or image input, then persists this as the model’s `input` capability metadata.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型新建/编辑页中新增“输入类型”字段，让用户手动声明模型是否支持文本、图片等输入能力并同步到模型配置中。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an Input Type field to DeepSeek Harness model creation/editing screens so users can manually declare capabilities like text and image input for custom models in the model configuration.

capabilities: Adds an Input Type UI control in the DeepSeek Harness model settings screen.
Updates the current model’s `input` capability field based on user-selected text/image options.
Supports text/image capability declaration without replacing Harness’s own validation and persistence workflow.

reasons.code: README explains the plugin adds an “输入类型” selector to the native Models settings page for configuring model input capabilities.
It maps selections like “文本 + 图片” to model `input` values such as ["text", "image"].
The plugin is described as only submitting the current model row patch while Harness continues validation and persistence.
